weakness: USB backup drive holding county extracts is unencrypted
source: P07 assessment (SC-28); P03 G-156; P01 R-004
remediation_plan: Wipe the drive, turn on the operating system's drive encryption (or buy an encrypted drive), copy back only current project folders, keep it in the locked file box
milestones: 2026-09-30 drive encrypted and county phase 1 data absent
resources_required: Encrypted drive about $90 if replaced; owner time

weakness: Website builder MFA off; city 311 offers contractors no MFA; 2024 city account still enabled
source: P07 assessment (IA-02(02)); P03 G-062; P01 R-011
remediation_plan: Turn on website builder MFA; city asked in writing on 2026-08-24 to disable the 2024 account and offer MFA; follow up until confirmed
milestones: 2026-09-30 website MFA on; 2026-10-31 city confirmation received

weakness: No record of where agency data lives; CJI found outside the sheriff's virtual desktop
source: P07 assessment (CM-12 objectives); P03 G-051 and CJ-05; P01 R-015
remediation_plan: Reported to the LASO 2026-08-25 and file deleted; sheriff disabled clipboard and drive mapping 2026-08-26; data location log per agency (POL-01 8.4); quarterly search of the laptop, sync folder, recycle bin, and backup drive
milestones: 2026-08-27 LASO accepted remediation; 2026-09-30 data location log started; 2026-11-30 first quarterly search done

weakness: Daily work in a local administrator account
source: P07 assessment (AC-06); P03 G-006; P01 R-001 and R-002
remediation_plan: Create a standard account for daily work; keep the administrator account for installs only, with a long unique password
resources_required: Owner time (1 hour) with the IT technician

weakness: County phase 1 extracts kept past the deletion date; no deletion, repair, or reuse procedure
source: P07 assessment (MP-06a. objectives); P03 G-090 and G-167; P01 R-003
remediation_plan: Delete every copy (laptop, sync folder, recycle bin, USB drive); send the county a deletion certificate; adopt POL-01 8.5 and 8.6
milestones: 2026-09-30 certificate sent to the county IT security officer

weakness: Backups manual, unencrypted, untested, and missing the scripts repository
source: P07 assessment (CP-09a. and CP-09d. objectives); P03 G-059; P01 R-010
remediation_plan: Automatic encrypted backup of project folders and the scripts repository to business cloud storage, separate from the sync folder; encrypted USB drive as the second copy; quarterly restore test
milestones: 2026-10-31 automatic backup running and first restore test passed

weakness: No post-incident or general security training; no awareness reminders; lessons not used
source: P07 assessment (AT-02a.02, AT-02b., AT-02d.); P03 G-019 and CJ-03
remediation_plan: CJIS refresher through the sheriff's program within 30 days of the 2026-08-25 incident; yearly security course with phishing practice; monthly reminders; add both 2026 events to the owner's training notes
milestones: 2026-09-24 CJIS refresher certificate; 2026-11-30 security course completed

weakness: Providers not reviewed; AI assistant used with agency data without terms
source: P07 assessment (SA-09 objectives); P03 G-135 and G-132; P01 R-005
remediation_plan: Provider list with data use, location, breach notice, and MFA per provider (P04); yearly review; Appendix A of POL-01 bars agency data from the AI assistant (P10)
milestones: 2026-09-30 AI assistant listed with no agency data allowed; 2026-10-31 all providers reviewed

weakness: Reporting clocks not written down before POL-01; no printed contact sheet
source: P07 assessment (IR-06a.); P03 G-076; P01 R-012
remediation_plan: POL-01 10.2 sets the clocks (adopted 2026-09-15); print the agency contact sheet; walk through P08 with the IT technician
milestones: 2026-09-30 contact sheet printed and with the attorney; 2026-10-31 walkthrough done

weakness: Laptop administrator account signs in with a password only
remediation_plan: After POAM-004, use the administrator account only for installs; give it a long unique password from the password manager; turn on the operating system's sign-in protection for administrator elevation
